```{r}
###############################################################################
# CHUNK X) SPLIT MEASURES (FROM REGISTRY) + REVERSE CODING (T0)
#
# Purpose
#   Build component-specific measure dataframes using registry_items, then apply
#   reverse coding using registry_items metadata (reversed_flag + numeric ranges).
#
# Outputs
#   - sensitive_measures_list_raw
#   - questionnaire_measures_list_raw
#   - sensitive_measures_list_rc
#   - questionnaire_measures_list_rc
#
# Notes
#   - Wave 0 has no sociometrics
#   - Expected components are:
#       * sensitive
#       * questionnaire
###############################################################################

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(stringr)
  library(purrr)
  library(tidyr)
})

stopifnot(exists("registry_items"))
stopifnot(exists("demo_final"))
stopifnot(exists("survey_final"))

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Helpers
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------

get_guts_col <- function(df) {
  guts_candidates <- c("gutsID", "guts_id", "gutsid", "GUTSID", "GutsID")
  guts_col <- guts_candidates[guts_candidates %in% names(df)][1]
  if (is.na(guts_col)) stop("Could not find a gutsID column in dataset.")
  guts_col
}

# Standardize registry once for downstream use
registry_items2 <- registry_items %>%
  mutate(
    component = tolower(str_squish(as.character(component))),
    short_name = str_squish(as.character(short_name)),
    variable_name = str_squish(as.character(variable_name)),
    variable_name_base = if ("variable_name_base" %in% names(.)) {
      str_squish(as.character(variable_name_base))
    } else {
      str_remove(variable_name, "_$")
    },
    is_prefix = if ("is_prefix" %in% names(.)) {
      as.logical(is_prefix)
    } else {
      str_ends(variable_name, "_")
    }
  )

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Splitter (registry-driven)
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------

split_component_measures_registry <- function(df, component_name, registry_items_df) {

  guts_col <- get_guts_col(df)

  reg <- registry_items_df %>%
    filter(component == component_name) %>%
    filter(!is.na(short_name), short_name != "") %>%
    filter(!is.na(variable_name), variable_name != "")

  if (nrow(reg) == 0) {
    message("No registry rows found for component: ", component_name)
    return(list())
  }

  measures <- reg %>%
    group_by(short_name) %>%
    summarise(vars = list(variable_name), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(
      data = purrr::map(vars, function(v) {

        selected_cols <- character(0)

        for (var in v) {

          prefix <- if (str_ends(var, "_")) var else paste0(var, "_")
          base   <- str_remove(var, "_$")

          exact_candidates <- unique(c(var, base))
          exact_match <- exact_candidates[exact_candidates %in% names(df)]
          prefix_match <- names(df)[str_starts(names(df), fixed(prefix))]

          if (length(exact_match) > 0 && length(prefix_match) > 0) {
            selected_cols <- c(selected_cols, exact_match[1], prefix_match)
          } else if (length(prefix_match) > 0) {
            selected_cols <- c(selected_cols, prefix_match)
          } else if (length(exact_match) > 0) {
            selected_cols <- c(selected_cols, exact_match[1])
          } else {
            stop("Variable not found in ", component_name, ": ", var)
          }
        }

        selected_cols <- unique(selected_cols)
        keep_cols <- c(guts_col, selected_cols)

        out <- df %>%
          select(all_of(keep_cols))

        if (guts_col != "gutsID") {
          out <- out %>% rename(gutsID = all_of(guts_col))
        }

        out
      })
    )

  out_list <- measures$data
  names(out_list) <- measures$short_name
  out_list
}

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Split lists (RAW)
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------

sensitive_measures_list_raw <- split_component_measures_registry(
  demo_final,
  "sensitive",
  registry_items2
)

questionnaire_measures_list_raw <- split_component_measures_registry(
  survey_final,
  "questionnaire",
  registry_items2
)

print(tibble(component = "sensitive",    n_measures = length(sensitive_measures_list_raw)))
print(tibble(component = "questionnaire", n_measures = length(questionnaire_measures_list_raw)))

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Reverse coding (registry-driven)
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------

apply_reverse_coding_registry <- function(measures_list_raw, component_name, registry_items_df) {

  reg <- registry_items_df %>%
    mutate(
      component = tolower(str_squish(as.character(component))),
      short_name = str_squish(as.character(short_name)),
      variable_name = str_squish(as.character(variable_name))
    ) %>%
    filter(component == component_name) %>%
    filter(reversed_flag == 1L) %>%
    filter(range_ok) %>%
    select(short_name, variable_name, scale_min, scale_max)

  if (nrow(reg) == 0) {
    message("Reverse coding (", component_name, "): no reversed items flagged with numeric ranges.")
    return(measures_list_raw)
  }

  measures_list_rc <- purrr::imap(measures_list_raw, function(df, meas) {

    info <- reg %>% filter(short_name == meas)
    if (nrow(info) == 0) return(df)

    for (i in seq_len(nrow(info))) {
      v  <- info$variable_name[i]
      mn <- info$scale_min[i]
      mx <- info$scale_max[i]

      if (v %in% names(df)) {
        x_num <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(df[[v]]))
        df[[v]] <- ifelse(is.na(x_num), NA_real_, (mn + mx) - x_num)
        next
      }

      prefix <- if (str_ends(v, "_")) v else paste0(v, "_")
      prefixed_cols <- names(df)[str_starts(names(df), fixed(prefix))]

      if (length(prefixed_cols) > 0) {
        for (col in prefixed_cols) {
          x_num <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(df[[col]]))
          df[[col]] <- ifelse(is.na(x_num), NA_real_, (mn + mx) - x_num)
        }
      }
    }

    df
  })

  rev_summary <- reg %>%
    group_by(short_name) %>%
    summarise(
      n_reversed = n(),
      reversed_vars = paste(variable_name, collapse = ", "),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    arrange(desc(n_reversed))

  message("Reverse-coding summary (", component_name, "):")
  print(rev_summary, n = Inf)

  measures_list_rc
}

sensitive_measures_list_rc <- apply_reverse_coding_registry(
  sensitive_measures_list_raw,
  "sensitive",
  registry_items2
)

questionnaire_measures_list_rc <- apply_reverse_coding_registry(
  questionnaire_measures_list_raw,
  "questionnaire",
  registry_items2
)

# Objects available downstream:
#   - sensitive_measures_list_raw
#   - questionnaire_measures_list_raw
#   - sensitive_measures_list_rc
#   - questionnaire_measures_list_rc

```

###############################################################################
# STEP X) EXPORT OUTPUTS (WAVE 0)
#
# Exports into ONE root folder:
#   <out_base_dir>/measures/
#
#   A) Measures (sensitive / questionnaire)
#      - <out_meas_dir>/<short_name>/
#
# Receipts:
#   <out_meas_dir>/_receipts/
###############################################################################

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(stringr)
  library(purrr)
  library(readr)
  library(haven)
  library(tibble)
})

# ---- Config ----
site_id <- "lei"
ses_id  <- "00"

out_base_dir <- file.path(dir0, "Behavioral", "T0", "data_processed")
out_meas_dir <- file.path(out_base_dir, "measures")
receipts_dir <- file.path(out_meas_dir, "_receipts")

timestamp_now <- format(Sys.time(), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")

# ---- Ensure folders exist ----
dir.create(out_meas_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(receipts_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

message("EXPORT ROOT (measures): ", out_meas_dir)
message("  Receipts dir:         ", receipts_dir)

# ---- Helpers ----
assert_safe_name <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  bad <- str_detect(x, "[\\\\/:*?\"<>|\\s]")
  if (any(bad)) {
    stop(
      "Unsafe name(s) for folder/file naming (contains space or invalid path character): ",
      paste(unique(x[bad]), collapse = ", ")
    )
  }
}

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# A) MEASURES EXPORT -> TSV + RDS + SAV
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------

stopifnot(exists("sensitive_measures_list_rc"))
stopifnot(exists("questionnaire_measures_list_rc"))

export_sets <- list(
  sensitive    = sensitive_measures_list_rc,
  questionnaire = questionnaire_measures_list_rc
)

export_measure_set <- function(measures_list, component_name) {
  if (length(measures_list) == 0) {
    message("No measures to export for component: ", component_name)
    return(tibble())
  }

  measure_names <- names(measures_list)
  assert_safe_name(measure_names)

  purrr::imap_dfr(measures_list, function(df, short_name) {

    measure_dir <- file.path(out_meas_dir, short_name)
    dir.create(measure_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

    stem <- paste0("guts-", site_id, "_ses-", ses_id, "_task-", short_name)

    path_tsv <- file.path(measure_dir, paste0(stem, ".tsv"))
    path_rds <- file.path(measure_dir, paste0(stem, ".rds"))
    path_sav <- file.path(measure_dir, paste0(stem, ".sav"))

    readr::write_tsv(df, path_tsv, na = "")
    saveRDS(df, path_rds)
    haven::write_sav(df, path_sav)

    tibble(
      export_type = "measures",
      component   = component_name,
      short_name  = short_name,
      n_rows      = nrow(df),
      n_cols      = ncol(df),
      path_tsv    = path_tsv,
      path_rds    = path_rds,
      path_sav    = path_sav,
      timestamp   = timestamp_now
    )
  })
}

meas_receipt <- purrr::imap_dfr(export_sets, export_measure_set)

meas_receipt_path <- file.path(receipts_dir, "export_receipt_measures.csv")
readr::write_csv(meas_receipt, meas_receipt_path)

message("Measures export complete. Receipt: ", meas_receipt_path)

print(meas_receipt %>% count(component, name = "n_measures_exported"))
message("All exports complete. Root: ", out_meas_dir)
